reels.caption:
POV: you just arrived to the dreamiest resort on earth ✨ Save this for your future trip here!

From the moment you step foot into Four Seasons Bora Bora, you are in paradise. Some places are better in person than you can even imagine, and this is one of them. Everything about our stay was perfection – the property is stunning, the staff is so welcoming and kind, and the lagoon view of Mt. Otemanu is iconic.🌸

TOP EXPERIENCES:

🔥 Watching the traditional Polynesian dances and fireshow
💆🏼‍♀️ Enjoying relaxing treatments at the world class spa
🪸 Taking a private snorkeling tour of the Coral Gardens
🦈 Swimming with the sharks and manta rays
🛶 Getting breakfast delivered to your villa by a canoe
🏝️ Having a private romantic dinner on the heart-shaped motu
🚁 Flying over Bora Bora in a helicopter for epic views

INSIDER TIPS: The best weather there is May - October and the best overwater villa to book is the mountain view with private plunge pool 💦

Send this to someone you would love to go here with! 🥂

Check out more reels and stories on this beautiful place at @andreaday_travel and follow for the world's dreamiest escapes! 🌴

A golden living!

Luxury is a feeling.
This living room is the perfect harmony of opulence and serenity, where every curve and texture speaks of refined elegance. The plush, circular seating invites warmth and connection, making the living room a space of both grandeur and comfort. Golden accents glisten under soft lighting, enhancing the timeless beauty of the decor. The ceiling mirrors the artistry below, amplifying the richness of the space with a touch of ethereal charm. Every detail, from the sculptural centerpiece to the sheer drapery, turns this living room into a sanctuary of modern luxury.
